reason: I'll start with recycling worn red cells to recover iron for new ones, as the picture and goal suggest.
expectation: The recycling cells will break down the worn cells and make their iron available, though I don't know exactly what form it will take.

alternatives.reason: Growing replacement skin cells is also a clear goal, but I'll follow the iron route first.

effect: The recovered iron is carried in blood by proteins, so I can now follow it to the bone marrow.
reaction: It was interesting that the iron travels attached to proteins rather than as metal fragments.
reason: I'll use the recovered iron in the marrow to continue the red blood cell goal.
expectation: I expect the marrow to use the iron to help make new red blood cells, though I don't know the intermediate steps.

alternatives.reason: Growing skin cells is another clear goal, but I want to finish the iron route first.

effect: The marrow used the recovered iron in new red cells while retaining its stem cells; the skin goal remains.
reaction: It's satisfying to see the iron reused without using up the marrow.
reason: This is the only available combination, and it supplies the dividing skin cells with materials for growth.
expectation: I expect new skin cells to grow while some cells remain at the base.

effect: The skin result shows new cells replacing shed cells while the base population and continuous covering remain; both goals are complete.
reaction: It was satisfying to see growth and shedding happen together.

mostWorthwhile.text: Using recovered iron in marrow was most worthwhile: it connected old red cells to new oxygen-carrying cells without using up the marrow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Growing the skin cells was clear but less engaging as the only available combination.

surprise.text: I was surprised that recovered iron travels in blood attached to proteins rather than as metal fragments.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals explained both pairings, although the compatible options were supplied.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see another connection like iron recycling, though the supplied pairings made this chapter fairly predictable.
